sources.title: Model Merging in Pre-training of Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Model merging has emerged as a promising technique for enhancing large language models, though its application in large-scale pre-training remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we present a comprehensive investigation of model merging techniques during the pre-training process.

sources.title: ByteDance Seed
sources.snippet: The ByteDance Seed team was established in 2023, dedicated to discovering new approaches to general intelligence, pushing the boundaries of AI. The team's research areas include LLM, speech, vision, world models, infrastructure, AI Infra, and next-generation AI interactions. The team operates labs in China, Singapore, the United States, and other locations.
